messages:
alex_g: opened a PR to update the nebula3b model card and model-catalog entry — mainly embed-sharding guidance, new bench numbers for 1/2/4 shard configs, and a couple of broken links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 please eyeball the SDK snippet that shows sharding behavior

maria_r: thanks alex — quick q: did you update the migration note for customers using the legacy embed endpoint? a lot of folks still call the old /v1/embeds path in examples.

alex_g: yes, added a Migration section but it’s terse. i tried to keep it short: explains changing endpoint, how to split shards, and a fallback note. would like someone from SDK docs to make the snippet idiomatic.

samuel_t: saw benchmark numbers, looks plausible but can we re-run the 4-shard profile on p4d? last run had a noisy neighbor and 99th p95 was higher than expected.

leo_w: quick SDK snippet suggestion — the current python example uses the old sync call. propose replacing with the new client.batch_embeddings helper and showing explicit shard param. e.g.

```python
# preferred: batching + shard hint
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=REDACTED)
queries = ["a", "b", "c"]
resp = client.embeddings.batch_create(model="nebula3b-embed", inputs=queries, shard_hint=2)
# resp.embeddings -> list of vectors
```

leo_w: that both reads nicer and maps to our internal batching recommendation.

maria_r: also we should add a small note about embedding truncation and tokenization differences vs generate models — customers keep getting surprises there.

alex_g: added a bullet under 'compatibility notes' for truncation and a pointer to the tokenizer page. i left a TODO to attach a short example that shows tokenization mismatch.

docs-bot: PR opened by alex_g: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 — labels: docs, model-catalog, needs-review.

ci-bot: docs build failed on linkcheck: 1 broken link (https://old.link/example).

alex_g: ah yeah that’s the broken link i mentioned — updating to https://docs.redwood.ai/tokenizer (will push fix in a sec)

ci-bot: docs build passed (after fix).

samuel_t: re-ran bench on p4d, attached quick numbers in PR comment. 4-shard 99th latency improved ~12% after minor config tweak. left a note on autoscaling recommendation.

maria_r: LGTM on wording, left two tiny nit comments on phrasing. leo_w — can you confirm the python snippet change?

leo_w: confirmed, pushed the snippet swap and moved the old example into an appendix with a deprecation note.

alex_g: awesome — merging after one more quick review. thanks everyone :tada:

maria_r: feel free to ping me if you want me to flip the live catalog card after merge (I usually do the publish step).

alex_g: will do — planning to publish after CI green and bench note accepted.
